content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-2|How a]]s face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-23|setting]] up online stores. This often leads to missed revenue opportunities and limited market access. COREMERCH addresses this issue by providing a robust infrastructure that empowers creators to establish their own digital storefronts, free from reliance on conventional payment systems. This guide will walk you through deploying Supabase as your order database, allowing you to process crypto payments seamlessly and efficiently.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often restrict access based on geography, leaving many creators without reliable options. COREMERCH’s approach establishes a sovereign infrastructure that eliminates these barriers. By leveraging tools like Supabase for order management and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you gain full control over your digital store. This setup not only allows you to accept payments from a global audience but also ensures that you own your data and operations [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-5|COREMERCH guide to complete]]ly, safeguarding your business against platform failures.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, ensure you have the essentials ready. You will need a GitHub account for hosting your website on GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions. Additionally, familiarize yourself with Supabase, which will serve as your order database. Collect any digital products you plan to sell and prepare them for upload. By assembling these components ahead of time, you streamline the deployment process and reduce potential delays.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by configuring NOWPayments with your store. This involves creating a payment button for each product you plan to sell and integrating it into your GitHub Pages site. Use Google Apps Script to manage order processing and confirm payments automatically. Once a payment is verified, your digital product should be delivered instantly through a service like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This ensures that your customers receive their purchases immediately, enhancing their experience and trust in your store.
Own your entire digital store infrastructure with no dependencies on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your infrastructure, it's time to go live. Begin by testing your order flow in a controlled environment to ensure everything operates smoothly. Once satisfied, publish your GitHub Pages site and start promoting it. Share the link on social media platforms and through your existing networks to generate traffic. When your first customer makes a purchase, closely monitor the transaction to confirm that the payment processing and product delivery functions correctly. This first sale is crucial for building confidence in your new digital store.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is live and operating effectively, consider strategies for scaling. You can expand your product offerings by adding more digital items and creating marketing campaigns to reach broader audiences. Utilize Supabase’s features to analyze order data and identify trends in customer purchases. This information can inform your inventory decisions and promotional strategies. Additionally, explore upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced capabilities, allowing for greater flexibility and more robust features as your business grows.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, deploy a solution like COREMERCH's Stack 01. This setup utilizes GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments, enabling you to create a fully operational store without traditional payment gateways. By leveraging these tools, you maintain full ownership of your data and operations.
Experience seamless crypto payments and instant product delivery without traditional banking.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account to host your website. Set up your NOWPayments account for crypto transactions. Prepare your digital products for upload. Configure Google Apps Script for order management. Create payment buttons with NOWPayments for each product. Ensure delivery is set up via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Conduct thorough testing of your payment and order processes. Publish your GitHub Pages site and share it to attract customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize COREMERCH's Stack 01. This involves deploying GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing payments. This combination allows you to sell digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours. In contrast, Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with end-to-end testing, providing a more comprehensive infrastructure for larger operations.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. GitHub Pages is ideal for Stack 01, while Cloudflare Pages suits Stack 02, offering better scalability and performance through advanced cloud functionality.
What payment options are available for digital stores using COREMERCH?

COREMERCH allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments. This service provides a straightforward, low-fee payment processing solution that eliminates the need for traditional banking systems.
How can I ensure product delivery after payment confirmation?

You can ensure product delivery by integrating Google Apps Script with NOWPayments. This setup will automatically trigger product delivery through services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 as soon as payment is confirmed on-chain.
